experts.district: chart-districts, kpi:national, insight:national, insight:thin — multi-valued; 'ארצי' (national) shown as its own column
experts.employer: chart-inst, insight:inst — institutes/centres are organisations; a value that is a language name (a shifted row) is ignored
experts.expert: kpi:experts — used only to drop broken continuation rows and to count an expert listed at several addresses once; no individual is named on the page
experts.adress: skip: street address — private contact detail, kept off the page by policy
experts.authority: chart-cities, insight:cities — multi-valued; spelling variants of the same city merged
experts.phone: skip: phone number — private contact detail
experts.cell_phone: skip: mobile phone number — private contact detail
experts.profession: chart-prof, chart-districts, chart-cities, chart-topics, chart-rates, chart-opinion, insight:prof, insight:rates, insight:op_prof — typos mapped; two professions count under the first
experts.opinion: kpi:experts — near-constant 'כן'; the share marked as giving opinions is stated in the lede
experts.payment: chart-rates, chart-opinion, kpi:rate, kpi:opinion, insight:rates, insight:opinion, insight:op_prof — free text parsed into an hourly/session rate and an opinion fee (rule stated on the chart)
experts.notes: chart-topics, insight:topics — keyword tagging only; the free text itself (which carries private e-mails) never reaches the page
experts.languages: chart-langs, insight:langs — multi-valued; only tokens that are language names are counted
